subject: Request for penetration findings and evidence transfer — proposed sanitization & delivery protocol
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@greenridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Singh <lara.singh@cybersafe-labs.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 14:11:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen-test findings + evidence for audit

Hi Logan / Neha,

Thanks again for the SOC2 walkthrough last week. As part of our audit evidence package we need the penetration test report (latest) and supporting evidence for a subset of findings. Our auditors (Cybersafe Labs) will need: the executive summary, copies of the individual test cases for critical/high findings, and associated log extracts or packet captures where applicable.

Can Redwood provide:
- Exec summary (PDF)
- Full report (we can accept a redacted copy if required)
- Evidence samples for 3 critical findings (logs/pcap/snapshots)

We understand there may be IP/customer redactions required — we can sign an NDA if that helps. Also please confirm the delivery mechanism (SFTP/secure transfer) and a rough ETA — the audit window opens 2025-10-10.

Appreciate advice on what you can share and any lead time required.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Compliance Programs
Greenridge Systems

--
Attachment: request_scan_manifest.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@greenridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen-test findings + evidence for audit

Daniel — thanks for the clear ask. We can support this, but we need to follow our evidence-sharing protocol to protect customer data and internal IP. High level:

- We can deliver an executive summary (unredacted) for your audit team and a redacted full report.
- Raw evidence (logs/pcaps) will be provided as a sampled bundle for the specific findings you identify; delivery will be via short-lived SFTP access.
- Before we move data, we require an executed mutual NDA and a signed data access attestation. I attached our standard NDA for review.

Attached: NDA-redwood-v2.pdf, redaction_matrix.xlsx (template).

Proposed next steps:
1) You sign the NDA (DocuSign link below) OR provide an approved legal redline.
2) Share which three finding IDs you want evidence for (use the manifest you attached or reference CVE/Redwood IDs).
3) We stage the evidence on SFTP and provide one-week ephemeral credentials; we also produce a short redaction summary showing what was removed.

Timeline: once NDA is returned, we can stage a redacted full report + sampled evidence within 3 business days. If you need the unredacted full bundle we will need an in-person data review or a mutually agreed secure review room (per section 4 of the NDA).

DocuSign (suggested): https://secure.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-REDWOOD-NDA
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/GR-9876

If this plan works I can loop in our security engineering lead to prepare the bundle.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Request: pen-test findings + evidence for audit

Logan — thanks, that plan sounds reasonable. Two quick clarifications from our auditor:
1) What redaction categories do you apply by default? (IP, customer IDs, internal hostnames, config snippets?)
2) For the sampled evidence, can Cybersafe request a checksum or manifest to verify samples haven’t been altered after transfer?

We can sign the NDA; I’ll start the DocuSign flow. Our three findings are: GRS-2025-07 (critical), GRS-2025-11 (high), GRS-2025-18 (high). Lara — can you confirm the minimum artifact types you need (logs vs full pcap)?

If possible we’d like the bundle staged by 2025-10-06 (COB) so auditors can ingest ahead of the window.

Thanks,
Daniel
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@greenridge.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2025 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen-test findings + evidence for audit

Hi Daniel / Lara / Logan,

Thanks — I’m the compliance lead handling this exchange and can own the redaction and transfer. Answers inline and a short delivery plan below.

Q: default redaction categories
A: We apply the following categories by default: customer identifiers (tenant IDs, account emails), external customer data, internal hostnames that resolve externally, private keys/credentials, third-party customer IDs. We do NOT redact vulnerability IDs, technical descriptions of findings, or remediation steps. The attached redaction_matrix.xlsx shows examples we apply to each category.

Q: checksum/manifest
A: yes — we will produce a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) for all staged artifacts. We can also provide a PGP-signed manifest on request.

Delivery plan (proposed):
- 2025-10-03: NDA fully executed (we see DocuSign completed).
- 2025-10-04: Security engineering prepares a sampled evidence bundle and creates the redacted full report (pen_test_rev2_redacted.pdf).
- 2025-10-05: Evidence bundle staged on SFTP; we send ephemeral credentials valid for 7 days; manifest + checksums attached.

What we will include in the bundle for the three finding IDs you listed:
- redacted report (PDF) — all customer-identifiable fields removed
- evidence_sample_list.txt — references to the artifacts staged (log excerpts, pcaps IDs)
- remediation_status_20251004.csv — current remediation state for each finding
- signed_manifest.sha256 (PGP optional)

Attachments: remediation_status_20251004.csv (csv, 24KB)

Note on unredacted access: If you need full unredacted artifacts, we require either: (a) a secure review session with an approved two-person audit team in our secure review room OR (b) a narrowly-scoped data-handback agreement and stronger contractual protections (we can discuss).

If that schedule looks good please complete the DocuSign NDA and I’ll confirm staging timelines.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Liaison | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0124

Daniel — I’m the security engineering lead; per Neha we’ve staged the artifacts and the redacted report is ready pending NDA completion. A couple of practical notes:

- Evidence will live on sftp.redwood-inference.com under /staging/greenridge/ and we’ll provide a one-time credential; we’ll also rotate passwords after download or at expiry.
